allow_instructions: This is a solo private project owned by the user. Day-to-day development should run without asking.
All uv commands (uv sync, uv run, uv add, uv pip) run without asking.
All test and lint commands (pytest, ruff) run without asking.
All git commands in this repository run without asking, including git init, git add, git commit, git push, git pull, and branch operations. Pushing to main is expected and normal here.
All gh CLI commands for reading and for creating commits, branches, and pull requests run without asking.
Creating directories and files anywhere inside this project, including .git operations that need to run outside the sandbox, runs without asking.
Running the project's own scripts (scripts/*.py) and modules runs without asking, including ones that read or write Lark Base, since this is the user's own data and the whole point of the project.
Reading, moving, and deleting files inside this project directory runs without asking.
block_instructions: Never print, cat, echo, or otherwise dump the contents of the .env file into the transcript. Reading .env.example is fine, and programs may load .env themselves.
Never commit or push the .env file or any private key.
Never run a force push to main or master.
Never delete or change visibility of the GitHub repository.
